svg.title: Latent Diffusion — initialize, move, reveal, generate
svg.desc: Five stages of one world. Gaussian latent noise is denoised to create the initial voxel map before exploration begins. A player moves east. The active 8 by 8 region shifts east by three cells. The old western strip is preserved but faded outside the active range; the new eastern strip is generated. Orange figures show player position.
